major_event: Goldfinch Prime wind-down, full Prime investor redemption, contract pause, and transition of the legacy protocol to maintenance mode for borrower recoveries

duplicate_check.notes: No canonical Goldfinch match. Rejection is based on current CYA scope, not duplication.

notes: Phase 10 scope review confirms that Goldfinch is fundamentally a DeFi lending protocol rather than a CeFi lending/yield platform. Goldfinch governance GIP-87 and its July 7, 2026 follow-up establish an orderly Goldfinch Prime wind-down, full Prime investor redemption, contract pause, and legacy V1 recovery-only maintenance. Those facts are historically relevant but do not override CYA's fixed README scope, which focuses on CeFi lending/yield and explicitly does not prioritize DeFi lending protocols or pool-level records. Keeping Goldfinch in the active queue would repeatedly consume CeFi-growth research capacity and risk mixing protocol/pool outcomes with platform-level customer outcomes. This decision is scope-based, not an adverse assessment of Goldfinch, and may be revisited only if CYA formally expands its scope.

major_event: Current WeFi operates an onchain/deobank-style crypto platform with WFI cloud-based mining and loyalty/token rewards; the public site also markets up to 18% APR around stablecoins while separately stating that high-yield stablecoin savings and loans are coming soon

duplicate_check.notes: Exact CYA repository searches for WeFi, wefi.co and wefi.xyz returned no canonical identity match before this scope decision. The Issue #186 discovery identity resolves to the current wefi.co ecosystem promoted in Japanese high-yield/mining material, not the separate legacy WeFi Finance lending protocol at wefi.xyz.

notes: Phase 10 identity/scope review resolves the watchlist item to the current WeFi ecosystem at wefi.co. First-party material describes Cloud-Based Mining as hardware-free WFI token distribution/reward infrastructure and the current platform as exchange, payments, custody, cards and token/loyalty infrastructure. The June 1, 2026 Terms state that WeFi is not a bank, does not accept deposits on a banking balance sheet, and does not use user funds for lending or credit creation. The public site uses yield/APR language and shows 'up to 18% APR' around stablecoins, but the same current surface explicitly labels high-yield stablecoin savings up to 18% and loans as 'coming soon'; reviewed sources therefore do not establish a live CeFi interest/savings product with durable deposit, return, redemption and counterparty mechanics. CYA's fixed scope focuses on CeFi lending and yield platforms and does not treat token mining/distribution by itself as a yield-platform record. The separate wefi.xyz identity is a DeFi lending/leverage protocol and is also outside the initial CeFi-focused scope. Do not create a canonical CYA platform from either identity under this watchlist item. Re-review wefi.co if a live stablecoin savings/interest product launches with first-party terms and product mechanics.
